naslov: EuroCup roundup: Hapoel beats Aris, easy wins for Venezia and Turk Telekom
tekst:
By Eurohoops team/ info@eurohoops.net
Türk Telekom achieved their first victory of the day by defeating Frankfurt with a score of 98-78.
Jerrick Harding led the winning team with 18 points, Uros Trifunovic had 15, Shaq McKissic scored 14, while Dogus Ozdemiroglu recorded a double-double with 13 points and 12 assists.
For the visitors, Nahiem Alleyne and Isaiah Swope each scored 15 points.
Manresa secured a new victory in the EuroCup by defeating Lietkabelis away with a score of 80-66, in a match where Luka Scuka, who recently joined the club, made his debut.
Lukasz Kolenda led the winning team with 14 points, while Chibuzo Agbo, Ferran Bassas, and Hugo Benitez each scored 11. For Lietkabelis, Alexander Schumacher scored 17 points, and Keondre Kennedy added 15.
Le Mans also claimed a victory after a significant comeback, winning the second half 43-25, to defeat Rigas Zelli away with a score of 71-65.
Leopold Delaunay scored 13 points for the winning team, and Lucas Dufeal had 11. For the hosts, Toms Skuja scored 13 points, one more than Tyler Wahl.
Cedevita survived an OT drama
In one of the most exciting matches, Cedevita Olimpija defeated Tortona at home with a score of 73-71, after overtime.
The hero for the home team was Anthony Cowan, who made two free throws four seconds before the end of overtime. Before that, Justin Gorham hit a three-pointer in the last second to force overtime.
Rihards Lomazs had 16 points and eight rebounds, while Noah Kirkwood and Jayce Johnson each added 12. For Tortona, Dante Maddox scored 13 points, and Gorham had 12.
The drama was resolved in favor of JL Bourg, who defeated Slask in Wroclaw with a score of 88-84.
Trey Woodbury scored 16 points, Tyrese Samuel had 14, and Tyger Campbell 13. For Slask, Devin Robinson scored 18 points, and Jakub Niziol 14.
Hapoel remains unbeaten
In a match between two undefeated teams, Hapoel Jerusalem secured a victory against Aris with a score of 84-73, keeping them at the top of their group.
The Israelis celebrated after a comeback, with the decisive blow to Aris coming in the final quarter, which Hapoel won 27-17.
Kenneth Lofton had 22 points and 10 rebounds, Shake Milton added 19, while Lorenzo Brown had 11. On the other side, Adam Mokoka scored 13 points, one more than EJ Liddell.
Balkan recorded their first victory in the competition by defeating Bosna away with a score of 78-69.
Javante McCoy dominated with 27 points, while Aleksandar Stoimenov had 19. For the hosts, Reginald Perry was the best with 21 points.
Comfortable win for Venezia, Maxima Roma triumphs after OT
Venezia secured another comfortable victory, defeating Siauliai at home with a score of 98-77.
Leonardo Candi scored 20 points, while Jordan Parks added 14. On the other side, Simas Jarumbauskas had 18 points, and Martynas Pacevicius 15.
In a very exciting match, Maxima Roma prevailed over London Lions in overtime with a score of 86-84.
Xavier Moon had 25 points, Aaron Holiday 17, and Miro Bilan 14 along with eight rebounds. On the other side, Maxwell Lewis scored 14 points, one more than DeVante Jones.
In the last match of the evening, Rostock dominated San Pablo Burgos away with a score of 86-59.
Taronte Crockett scored 19 points for Rostock, while Zach Copeland added 13, along with seven assists. For Burgos, only DJ Steward managed to score 14 points.
Tenerife wins by 40
Tenerife delivered an outstanding basketball performance to decisively defeat U-BT Cluj-Napoca 113-73, solidifying their position at the top of their group with a record of five wins and one loss (5-1).
Individually, Jaime Fernández and Giorgi Shermadini particularly stood out. The Spanish guard led Tenerife’s offense with 22 points, while the Georgian center added another 21, becoming two of the main protagonists of a perfect night for the Canary Islands team.
For Cluj, Malcolm Hill scored 21 points, while Javonte Smart and Javon Bess each added 10.
